done_when: Parallel test workers never see a half-built or missing cached SDK: the rebuild builds in a private folder and moves it into place under a lock, and a test with two concurrent rebuilds passes

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Test. The second worker waits here until the first rebuild has published and returned, so the publication sections never overlap. Removing the lock acquisition and release from `_cached_sdk` would still pass both parametrizations, despite allowing simultaneous publishers to both observe a broken cache and then delete or replace each other's publication. The required publication-lock behavior therefore lacks regression coverage. Extend this test so two completed private builds contend for publication and an ineffective lock causes failure.
findings.title: Gate: test_1_concurrent_rebuilds_keep_one_ready_sdk

why: In CI, parallel test workers sometimes find the tests' cached Claude Agent SDK missing, because the cache rebuild added after the restart is not safe when two workers rebuild at once
